title: Lead Software Engineer - Java with Spring Boot
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking an experienced **Lead Software Engineer** to own end-to-end delivery of software solutions while guiding a technical team. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and delivery of enhancements for customer-facing applications, working across a modern technology stack deployed on cloud infrastructure.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead enhancement design, development, and delivery for customer-facing applications
* Support a high release cadence (20+ releases/month) through the GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline
* Work across the technology stack, including Spring, Java, and PostgreSQL
* Apply the minor-enhancement boundary (approximately 5 working days / 40 hours) when scoping incoming requests
* Coordinate with the Enhancement Architect on design alignment and technical risk
* Provide technical guidance to Engineers supporting the application portfolio
* Own end-to-end delivery of software solutions while guiding and mentoring the technical team

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related STEM field
* 10+ years of experience in software development, testing, and implementation
* At least 1 year of relevant leadership experience
* Proficiency in Java and SQL
* Expertise in Spring Boot and microservices deployment
* Background in GitHub Actions and CI/CD practices supporting a high release cadence (20+ releases/month)
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL

**Nice to have**

* Knowledge of Redis and RabbitMQ
* Experience deploying dockerized microservices
* Familiarity with AWS and Azure cloud environments

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Backend Developer
description:
**We’re Hiring: Backend Developer**

**Join Our Team and Build Powerful Digital Solutions!**

We are looking for a skilled and motivated **Backend Developer** to design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance backend systems.

Job Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain robust backend applications and APIs.
* Design and manage databases for efficient data storage and retrieval.
* Integrate third-party services, APIs, and payment gateways.
* Optimize application performance, security, and scalability.
* Collaborate with frontend developers and the product team.
* Troubleshoot issues and ensure smooth system operations.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of backend technologies such as Node.js, Python, PHP, Java, or similar.
* Experience with REST APIs and database management (MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB).
* Understanding of authentication, security, and server-side architecture.
* Familiarity with Git, cloud platforms, and deployment processes is a plus.
* Strong problem-solving and communication skills.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
